ten: Công nghệ & bị động quá khứ
script_nghe: What’s the problem? … It’s my laptop. The screen is broken — I dropped it. … I see. When did you buy it? … About four years ago. … Right. We’ll need to replace the screen, and I should tell you the battery is also failing, but you said screen only? … Screen only for now, yes. … Then it’ll be ready on Thursday. Sorry — Wednesday, we’ve had a cancellation.

phan.noi_dung:
**REPAIR SERVICE FORM**

- Item: **1** ____________
- Problem: the **2** ____________ is broken
- When bought: **3** ____________ years ago
- Part to be replaced: the **4** ____________
- Ready on: **5** ____________

**Matching Information.** Đoạn nào (A–D) chứa thông tin sau?

> **A.** The first practical mobile telephone call was made in 1973 by an engineer standing on a New York street. The device weighed over a kilogram and offered thirty minutes of talk time after ten hours of charging. It was not sold to the public for another decade.
> 
> **B.** Early handsets were marketed almost entirely to business users. They were priced at roughly the cost of a small car, and advertisements emphasised status rather than convenience. Manufacturers expected the total world market to reach perhaps one million users.
> 
> **C.** That forecast proved to be one of the least accurate in commercial history. By 2020, more mobile connections existed than people on the planet. The change was driven less by improvements in the phones themselves than by falling prices and the spread of networks into rural areas.
> 
> **D.** Some consequences were not anticipated. In several countries with weak banking systems, mobile money services were adopted faster than in wealthy nations, allowing people who had never held a bank account to send and receive payments.

1. A description of how heavy the first device was → ____
1. A prediction that turned out to be badly wrong → ____
1. An unexpected use of the technology → ____
1. The reason the market grew so quickly → ____

**Hoàn thành câu (10–11):**
10. The first call was made in ____________.
11. Early handsets cost about as much as a ____________.

Viết **80–90 từ** mô tả một thiết bị bạn đang dùng: được sản xuất ở đâu, mua khi nào, đã từng được sửa chưa, dùng để làm gì.
*Tiêu chí: bị động ở ≥3 thì khác nhau (3đ) · has/have been + V3 đúng (1đ) · đủ ý (1đ).*

1. What technology do you use most every day?
1. Has technology made life better or worse?
1. What device could you not live without?

writing.de_tom_tat: Viết 80–90 từ mô tả một thiết bị bạn đang dùng: sản xuất ở đâu, mua khi nào, đã từng sửa chưa, dùng làm gì.
writing.bai_mau: My laptop was made in China and it was bought about three years ago. It was quite expensive at the time, but it has been worth the money. The battery was replaced last year because it was no longer holding a charge. Apart from that, it has never been repaired. It is used mainly for work — managing website data and writing small programs. It is also used for studying English.

cham_diem.vi_sao: was made · was bought · was replaced · was no longer holding · has never been repaired (bị động hiện tại hoàn thành). Đủ và chia đúng.
It is used mainly for work · It is also used for studying. Phân biệt rõ với bị động quá khứ.
Nơi sản xuất · thời điểm mua · lịch sử sửa chữa · mục đích dùng.

dang_hoc: Bị động quá khứ: was/were + V3. Bị động hiện tại: is/are + V3.
Bị động hiện tại hoàn thành: has/have been + V3 — "it has never been repaired".
Khi không biết hoặc không quan tâm ai làm thì bị động là lựa chọn tự nhiên nhất.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ It was buy three years ago → ✅ It was bought
❌ It has never repaired → ✅ It has never been repaired
❌ It used for work → ✅ It is used for work

speaking.de_tom_tat: Describe a device you use every day. / How has technology changed your work? / Do you worry about AI?

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Describe a device you use every day.
cau_tra_loi.mau: My laptop. It was bought three years ago and it's used for almost everything — work, studying, even watching films. The battery was replaced last year but otherwise it's never been repaired.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Dùng bị động tự nhiên trong hội thoại: was bought, is used, was replaced, has been repaired.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: How has technology changed your work?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Enormously. Tasks that used to be done by hand are now automated. I've written tools which process data overnight, so reports are ready before I arrive.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "used to be done by hand" — bị động kết hợp used to, cấu trúc nâng điểm.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: Do you worry about AI replacing your job?
cau_tra_loi.mau: Parts of it will be automated, certainly. But I'd rather learn to use these tools than compete with them. The people who adapt will be fine.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "I'd rather… than…" thể hiện quan điểm rõ ràng, và câu cuối là nhận định khái quát.

cham_diem.vi_sao: was bought · is used · was replaced · been repaired · be done · be automated.
Đủ, câu 3 có quan điểm cá nhân rõ.
automated /ˈɔːtəmeɪtɪd/ — bốn âm tiết, trọng âm đầu.

meo_noi: Bị động rất tự nhiên khi tả đồ vật — đừng nghĩ nó chỉ dùng trong văn viết.
"I'd rather A than B" — sau cả hai đều là động từ nguyên mẫu không to.
